boards.title: Your First Weekend at Elizabethtown College, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A practical Friday-to-Sunday sequence for learning campus, finding food and study options, and trying low-pressure recreation.

cards.title: Start at the BSC Terrace
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · establish your campus bearings
cards.notes: Begin where official campus tours depart, then identify the Commons, dining hall, library, and route back to your residence.
cards.short_summary: Use a familiar tour departure point to turn the campus map into a few memorable routes.
cards.evidence_claim: Elizabethtown College states that campus tours depart from the Baugher Student Center Terrace, moving inside the BSC concourse if it rains.
cards.access_notes: The cited page identifies the terrace as a campus-tour departure point; public access outside scheduled visit programming is not specified.

cards.title: Make Dinner Logistics Easy
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · learn the main dining hall
cards.notes: Eat once without overplanning, note the serving layout, and ask the host how your meal plan and OZZI container balance work.
cards.short_summary: A first meal here clarifies the dining system before the weekday schedule begins.
cards.evidence_claim: The Marketplace is on the second floor of Baugher Student Center and offers all-you-care-to-eat dining with meal-plan and paid entry options.
cards.access_notes: Normal operating times are presented dynamically on the official page and may change; check the live listing before going.

cards.title: Find the Weekend Board
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · check current student programming
cards.notes: Stop at the HUB during posted hours, open Etown Involve, and save one suitable weekend event rather than guessing what is scheduled.
cards.short_summary: This is the official starting point for finding current campus events and organization activity.
cards.evidence_claim: The HUB in Brossman Commons houses the Office of Student Activities and provides event sign-ups, ticket purchases, and campus-program information.
cards.source_title: Office of Student Activities | Elizabethtown College
cards.access_notes: The official page posts academic-year HUB hours as Monday through Friday, 10 a.m.–7 p.m.; event schedules should be checked in Etown Involve.

cards.title: Choose a Low-Key Game
cards.subtitle: Friday night · settle in without a formal event
cards.notes: Bring a roommate or hallmate, try the pool or ping-pong table, and keep this common room as a fallback when plans change.
cards.short_summary: A campus common room offers an easy, weather-proof first-night activity.
cards.evidence_claim: The College describes the Bird Cage in Baugher Student Center as a common room with a pool table, ping-pong table, and large television.
cards.access_notes: The official page does not publish room hours or equipment-availability guarantees; follow building access and posted-use rules.

cards.entity_name: Bowers Center for Sports, Fitness and Well-Being
cards.title: Learn the Recreation Setup
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · establish an active-campus option
cards.notes: Bring your student ID, check in at the welcome desk, and locate the fieldhouse, indoor track, fitness equipment, and Well.
cards.short_summary: A brief orientation makes the campus recreation complex easier to use later.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bowers Center is an 81,900-square-foot sports, fitness, and well-being facility whose access includes Elizabethtown College students with valid identification.
cards.source_title: The Bowers Center for Sports, Fitness & Well-Being | Elizabethtown College
cards.access_notes: Student access requires valid identification. Current facility hours are not stated on the cited overview, so verify them before visiting.

cards.entity_name: RecRe Box at the Bowers Center
cards.title: Borrow Something for the Lawn
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · turn equipment checkout into a plan
cards.notes: Scan the box QR code, create the required account, choose an available lawn game, and return every item through the same system.
cards.short_summary: The automated checkout box makes a casual group activity possible without bringing equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: Student Activities operates a RecRe Box behind the Bowers Center near the sand volleyball court, offering items such as Spikeball, Frisbees, and soccer balls.
cards.source_title: Office of Student Activities | Elizabethtown College
cards.access_notes: Users scan the QR code and create an account. Inventory and checkout availability can vary, and all borrowed items must be returned.

cards.title: Take the Game to Brinser Field
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · use a central outdoor field
cards.notes: Walk the borrowed gear to Brinser Field, keep clear of scheduled athletics, and choose a simple activity the whole group can join.
cards.short_summary: A named central lawn provides a clear destination for casual outdoor recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: Elizabethtown College identifies Brinser Field as a large grassy field beside Wolf Field and Brossman Commons that supports multiple outdoor activities.
cards.access_notes: No public schedule is supplied on the cited page; yield to organized activities, field closures, and posted campus rules.

cards.title: Claim a Study Reference Point
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · prepare for the first assignments
cards.notes: Walk the first floor, find printing and research help, then reserve a study room if you want a dependable place for the week.
cards.short_summary: A short library visit locates practical academic services before classes accelerate.
cards.evidence_claim: High Library offers physical and digital collections, study-room booking, librarian help, printing, and on-site study space.
cards.access_notes: Building hours are not stated on the cited landing page. Reference-desk hours differ from building access, so check the library’s live information.

cards.title: Pause on the Academic Quad
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · connect the academic buildings
cards.notes: Use the picnic tables or Adirondack chairs for a short break, then trace your Monday route between nearby academic buildings.
cards.short_summary: This central lawn doubles as a rest stop and a practical route-planning landmark.
cards.evidence_claim: The College describes the Academic Quad as a large central grassy area beside Brossman Commons with picnic tables and nearby Adirondack chairs.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor use depends on weather, campus programming, and any posted restrictions; no operating hours are listed.

cards.title: Finish with a Campus Landmark
cards.subtitle: Sunday · close the loop before classes
cards.notes: End with a daylight walk through the Dell, locate it on the official map, and use the landmark to review your weekend routes.
cards.short_summary: A final walk anchors the weekend around a named outdoor campus venue.
cards.evidence_claim: Elizabethtown College’s official campus map lists The Dell as a named campus destination, and the College uses it for outdoor Commencement ceremonies.
cards.access_notes: The Dell is an outdoor campus venue; avoid scheduled ceremonies or setups and follow any temporary access restrictions.
